Key threads from this canonical page lead to LEGO, Minions: The Rise of Gru, Speed Champions, Brick Sketches, Jurassic World and Architecture. Each link is another long-tail path through the subject.

How Portal:Themes connects

These mapped links are unique to this page — each one is another long-tail route through the subject graph.

  • Topic: LEGO — Part of
  • Topic: Minions: The Rise of Gru — Portal:Themes's entry mentions Minions: The Rise of Gru — Minions: The Rise of Gru is a licensed LEGO theme first released on April 27, 2020 based on the film of the same name.
  • Topic: Speed Champions — Portal:Themes's entry mentions Speed Champions — Speed Champions is a theme introduced in March 2015. The theme features classic and modern styles from well-known car brands, as well as pop-culture based cars.
  • Topic: Brick Sketches — Portal:Themes's entry mentions Brick Sketches — Brick Sketches is a theme that was released on June 15, 2020.
  • Topic: Jurassic World — Portal:Themes's entry mentions Jurassic World — Jurassic World is a theme introduced in May 2015 to coincide with the Jurassic World film. The sets are based on the Jurassic Park franchise.
  • Topic: Architecture — Portal:Themes's entry mentions Architecture — Architecture is a current theme introduced in 2008. All the sets have been designed by Chicago architect Adam Reed Tucker.
  • Topic: Super Heroes — Portal:Themes's entry mentions Super Heroes — Super Heroes is a licensed theme introduced in January 2012, although, in reality, 2011. Certain promotional sets were available in the Summer and early December of 2011.
  • Topic: Minifigures — Portal:Themes's entry mentions Minifigures — Minifigures, also known as Collectible Minifigures are a theme introduced in May 2010.
